message: No detected untrusted source handling: Data is fetched from the Riot Games API via plain HTTPS requests with no checksum verification, signature validation, or pinned revisions to confirm integrity of the remote source.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only checks that the winner field is derived from the 'win' field in the API response with no validation of label distributions or checks against an expected label set before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code performs only basic structural checks (missing gameId, duplicate roles, None values in matchTuple) but no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The getModel function loads the .pkl file with pickle.load() directly from the filesystem without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision check before deserialization.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distribution before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries or mechanisms (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no adversarial robustness testing present; no Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, or any other adversarial attack framework is used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The evaluation uses sklearn metrics but there is no isolated held-out test set, no signing or hashing of evaluation data, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against manipulation.

No detected output bounds checks: The getPrediction function returns raw model outputs (class prediction and predict_proba confidence) without any sanity checks on probability bounds, NaN guards, or threshold validation before returning them.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses a tabular ML model (RandomForest/DecisionTree) for game outcome prediction, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
